target.name: Timothy Overturf
target.context: Business intelligence investigation for due diligence

risk_flags.description: The SEC filed a federal-court enforcement action/complaint against Timothy Overturf and Sisu Capital, LLC alleging unauthorized and unsuitable trading and breach of fiduciary duties to clients. This is confirmed by the SEC complaint and litigation release, both primary regulatory sources.

Timothy Overturf is connected to Hansueli/Hans Overturf, whose own validated claims show a suspension from providing investment advisory services by the State of California. This creates a documented risk-relevant network link rather than a mere family association.

Regional coverage and industry reporting repeat the SEC allegations against Overturf and Sisu Capital, creating sustained public negative press around client trading and fiduciary-breach allegations. The coverage is serious, but the underlying reporting is still primarily single-domain Tier-3/secondary coverage rather than broad multi-outlet corroboration.

No validated claims were found for the financial dimension beyond the SEC-enforcement fact pattern and role-based references. Public records here do not materially cover personal assets, debt/default history, bankruptcy, or other broader financial-condition indicators.

Coverage of the broader reputational dimension is thin outside the SEC-allegation coverage. There are no validated claims showing independent public controversy, corrections, or multi-outlet press beyond the enforcement-related articles already noted.

No validated claims indicate contradictory facts sufficient to support an inconsistency finding. The record is sparse on disputed dates, roles, or financial figures, so this dimension remains undercovered.
